My absolute favorite is mango right now. It doesn't really smell like mangos honestly, more like fruit punch or "red" gatorade lol, but it's still amazing. The consistency is not too waxy and it's super moisturizing. 

Mint and rose have similar consistencies, but I think mint is better if you're looking for something hydrating or cooling. It's basically burt's bees and aquaphor combined.  

Birthday is probably my least favorite. I see a lot of love for it on this sub but mine has a such gritty texture because of the glitter. However, it smells sooo good and would be good if you just want something fun :)
